inline_comments.comment: The test does not include a case with exactly 11 Level 2 nodes — the highest-index node that should *not* wrap. Testing the upper boundary (index 10 → section 10) in isolation from the wrap-around case would make it explicit that the off-by-one is correct (i.e., the 11th node is still valid, and wrapping begins only at the 12th). Consider adding a short dedicated `it` for the boundary, or at minimum a comment explaining why 11 was chosen as the modulus.

general_comments.comment: The original issue is described as a visual rendering bug (nodes appeared black and disconnected). The fix is verified at the DB/unit-test layer by asserting the correct `cssClasses` string, which is good. However, no Cypress end-to-end or image-snapshot test is added to confirm the visual output is actually correct once the diagram is rendered in the browser. A minimal `imgSnapshotTest` in `cypress/integration/rendering/mindmap.spec.ts` with a mindmap containing 13–15 Level 2 nodes would guard against regressions at the rendering layer and would have caught the original bug had it existed previously.
